description: Lists the accounts filings of the signed-in account, newest first. Each accepted filing gives the receipt name that revision.revisesReceipt takes, the company number, the period, the type of accounts, whether it is itself revised accounts, whether it went with a Company Tax Return, and revisable. A rejected filing gives its submission number and Companies House's reasons. A receipt that cannot be read gives problem with the reason. It lists the newest 25 filings and answers more true when there are older ones. clientId narrows the list to one of a practice's clients. Use this when the person asks which accounts they have filed, whether Companies House accepted or rejected them, or before revising accounts already filed. It does not file, change or revise anything.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to list that client's accounts filings
